qs.html: My brother is really into ______. He plays the guitar, the piano, and the drums.
qs.exp: 他會彈吉他、鋼琴和打鼓，所以他熱衷的是「音樂」（music）。be into 是「熱衷於」。

qs.html: It's raining cats and dogs outside. Don't forget to take your ______ with you.
qs.exp: raining cats and dogs 是「下傾盆大雨」，所以要帶傘（umbrella）。

qs.html: Amy loves Japanese food. She has ______ to Japan three times.
qs.exp: 現在完成式 has/have + 過去分詞。have been to 表示「去過某地（已經回來）」，所以用 been。

qs.html: This chocolate cake looks great! It ______ by my mom last night.
qs.exp: 蛋糕是「被做」的，用被動語態 be + 過去分詞；last night 是過去時間，所以用 was made。

qs.html: Excuse me. Could you tell me ______ the next train will arrive?
qs.exp: 問的是火車「什麼時候」到，間接問句用 when + 主詞 + 動詞：when the next train will arrive。

qs.html: Kevin is the ______ runner in our class. Nobody runs faster than he does.
qs.exp: 沒有人跑得比他快，表示他是全班「最快」的。the + 最高級：the fastest。fast 是單音節，不用 most。

qs.html: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch movies.
qs.exp: 表示未來可能情況的 if 子句，用現在式代替未來式：If it rains tomorrow, we will…

qs.html:
Tom: Would you like some more tea?
Lisa: ______ I've had enough.
qs.exp: Lisa 說「我已經喝夠了」，所以要婉拒：No, thanks.

qs.html: The movie was so ______ that I fell asleep halfway through it.
qs.exp: 看到一半睡著了，表示電影很「無聊」（boring）。so…that… 表示「如此……以致於……」。

qs.html: Neither Ben nor his sisters ______ at home right now. They are all at school.
qs.exp: neither A nor B 的動詞和較靠近的 B 一致；his sisters 是複數，加上 right now 用現在式，所以用 are。

qs.passage:
Hi Grandma,

Thanks for the birthday card and the money! I used part of it to buy a new pair of running shoes, because my old ones were too small. I put the rest in the bank. I'm saving for a bike, so I can ride to school with my friends next year. Mom says if I save half of the price by December, she'll pay the other half.

School is busy. We have a big science fair next month, and my team is making a robot that can pick up trash. It's hard work, but it's fun.

Can you come for Christmas this year? We all miss you.

Love,
Owen
qs.html: Why did Owen buy new running shoes?
opts: His old ones were too small.
qs.exp: 信中說 because my old ones were too small，舊鞋太小了。

qs.html: What do we know about the bike?
opts: He will ride it to the science fair.
Grandma gave it to him as a gift.
His mom will pay for half of it if he saves enough.
qs.exp: Mom says if I save half of the price by December, she'll pay the other half：如果他在12月前存到一半，媽媽會付另一半。他還在存錢，還沒買。

qs.html: What is the main purpose of Owen's letter?
opts: To invite Grandma to the science fair.
To ask Grandma for more money.
To explain how to build a robot.
To thank Grandma and share his news.
qs.exp: 信一開始感謝奶奶的卡片和錢，接著分享買鞋、存錢、科展的近況，最後邀請奶奶來過聖誕節。主要目的是道謝和分享近況。

qs.passage:
City Swimming Pool — Summer Hours

Monday–Friday: 6:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.
Saturday–Sunday: 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.

Tickets: Adults $100 / Students (with ID) $60 / Children under 6: free

* Swimming caps are required. Caps can be bought at the front desk ($50).
* The pool is closed for cleaning on the first Monday of every month.
qs.html: Jenny, a junior high student, goes to the pool alone. She brings her student ID but forgets her swimming cap. How much does she need to pay?
qs.exp: 學生票（有學生證）$60，加上一定要戴泳帽，要在櫃臺買一頂 $50，共 $110。

qs.html: Which is true about the City Swimming Pool?
opts: You can swim there at 7:00 a.m. on Sunday.
It is open until 9:00 p.m. on Saturday.
It is closed on the first Monday of every month.
qs.exp: 告示寫 closed for cleaning on the first Monday of every month。(B)(C)週末是 8:00 a.m.～6:00 p.m.；(A)6歲以下免費。
